statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-6772 is a boundary error in how NSS records the TLS extensions negotiated during a handshake: each extension handler appended to the negotiated-extensions list directly. Mozilla fixed it in Firefox 150, Firefox ESR 115.35 and Firefox ESR 140.10: https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-30/#CVE-2026-6772. The fix, Mozilla bug 2026089, adds ssl3_RecordExtensionNegotiated() in lib/ssl/ssl3ext.c, which appends only while the list holds fewer than SSL_MAX_EXTENSIONS entries, and changes the handlers in ssl3exthandle.c, tls13exthandle.c and tls13ech.c to use it: https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/projects/nss/rev/961f1a40f5e7. The NSS 3.131.1, 3.132 and 3.134 release tags contain it. Debian fixed it in trixie in 2:3.110-1+deb13u2, DSA-6290-1, and lists 2:3.123-1 as the fixed version in unstable: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-6772. The DHI Debian repository publishes four builds of nss for Debian 13: a rebuild of Debian's 2:3.110-1+deb13u4 and builds of NSS 3.131.1, 3.132 and 3.134. We checked the libnss3 and libnss3-dbgsym packages of each on amd64 and arm64, verified against the index checksums: in every one, the libssl3.so debug symbols include ssl3_RecordExtensionNegotiated(), a function the NSS 3.110 release source does not have, next to ssl3_ExtensionNegotiated(), which both versions have. The libnssutil3.so version strings confirm NSS 3.110, 3.131.1, 3.132 and 3.134. As a control, the libssl3.so debug symbols of Debian's unfixed libnss3 2:3.110-1+deb13u1 for amd64 have ssl3_ExtensionNegotiated() but no ssl3_RecordExtensionNegotiated(). The changelog shipped in the 2:3.110-1+deb13u4 rebuild lists this CVE under Debian's 2:3.110-1+deb13u2 entry. Every published build carries the fix, so the range closes at the lowest published build, the 2:3.110-1+deb13u4 rebuild.
